def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Cap outgoing edges per (batch, winner) row. 0 => uncapped.
    max_out_per_item = int(hp.get('max_out_per_item', 0))

    # Anchor star (best -> top-gap losers).
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 2))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    # Adaptive dense+anchor filter: keep pairs with gap >= per-instance quantile.
    # 1.0 => keep all; 0.9 => keep top 10% by gap within each instance.
    keep_quantile = float(hp.get('keep_quantile', 1.0))

    # Hard cap per instance at the end. 0 => uncapped.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Directed strict improvement edges: i (winner) beats j (loser) if oi < oj.
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one per unordered pair.
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        keep = i_d < j_d
        b_d = b_d[keep]
        i_d = i_d[keep]
        j_d = j_d[keep]

    gap_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Row-cap: per (b, winner=i) keep top-k losers by gap.
    if max_out_per_item is not None and max_out_per_item > 0 and N > 0 and b_d.numel() > 0:
        score_row = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score_row[b_d, i_d, j_d] = gap_d

        k_row = max_out_per_item
        if k_row < 1:
            k_row = 1
        if k_row > N:
            k_row = N

        vals_r, idx_r = score_row.topk(k_row, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B,N,k)
        valid_r = vals_r.isfinite()
        nz = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        b_d = nz[0]
        i_d = nz[1]
        kk = nz[2]
        j_d = idx_r[b_d, i_d, kk]
        gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Anchor star: best beats top-gap losers (vectorized).
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap_to_best = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap_to_best > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap_to_best, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = top.indices[picked]
        gap_a = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]

    # Merge dense + anchor.
    if b_a.numel() > 0 and b_d.numel() > 0:
        b_all = torch.cat([b_d, b_a], dim=0)
        i_all = torch.cat([i_d, i_a], dim=0)
        j_all = torch.cat([j_d, j_a], dim=0)
        gap_all = torch.cat([gap_d, gap_a], dim=0)
    elif b_a.numel() > 0:
        b_all, i_all, j_all, gap_all = b_a, i_a, j_a, gap_a
    else:
        b_all, i_all, j_all, gap_all = b_d, i_d, j_d, gap_d

    # Per-instance quantile filter on gap strength (adaptive difficulty).
    if keep_quantile is not None and keep_quantile < 1.0 and b_all.numel() > 0:
        q = keep_quantile
        if q < 0.0:
            q = 0.0
        if q > 1.0:
            q = 1.0

        score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score[b_all, i_all, j_all] = gap_all
        flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
        finite = flat.isfinite()

        flat_safe = flat.where(finite, flat.new_zeros(()))
        any_finite = finite.any(dim=1, keepdim=True)

        thr = flat_safe.quantile(q, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        thr = thr.where(any_finite, flat.new_full((B, 1), float('inf')))

        keep = flat >= thr
        flat2 = flat.where(keep, flat.new_full((), float('-inf')))

        # Convert back to indices by taking all finite kept entries.
        kept = flat2.isfinite()
        b2, pos = kept.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N

        b_all, i_all, j_all = b2, i2, j2

    # Hard per-instance cap at the end (vectorized topk per instance).
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0 and b_all.numel() > 0:
        score3 = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score3[b_all, i_all, j_all] = objective[b_all, j_all] - objective[b_all, i_all]

        flat3 = score3.reshape(B, N * N)
        k_eff = max_pairs_per_instance
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if flat3.shape[1] > 0 and k_eff > flat3.shape[1]:
            k_eff = flat3.shape[1]

        vals, idx = flat3.topk(k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        valid = vals.isfinite()
        b2 = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        pos = idx[valid]
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N
        b_all, i_all, j_all = b2, i2, j2

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_all, i_all, j_all),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_rowcap_quantile_instcap',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'max_out_per_item': int(max_out_per_item),
            'anchor_k': int(anchor_k),
            'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap),
            'keep_quantile': float(keep_quantile),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
        },
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Cap outgoing edges per (batch, winner row). 0 => uncapped.
    max_out_per_item = int(hp.get('max_out_per_item', 0))

    # Per-instance percentile cap: keep pairs with gap >= quantile within each batch item.
    # q in [0,1]. Higher q => fewer, stronger pairs. If q<=0 => keep all.
    inst_gap_quantile = float(hp.get('inst_gap_quantile', 0.0))

    # Optional global safety cap after percentile filtering. 0 => uncapped.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))

    # Optional best-anchor star (best -> top-gap losers).
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense strict-improvement candidates.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one representative per unordered pair.
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        keep = i_d < j_d
        b_d = b_d[keep]
        i_d = i_d[keep]
        j_d = j_d[keep]

    # Score by objective gap (loser - winner), larger is stronger.
    gap_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Row-cap on dense pairs to prevent a single (b,i) winner dominating.
    if max_out_per_item is not None and max_out_per_item > 0 and N > 0 and b_d.numel() > 0:
        score_row = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score_row[b_d, i_d, j_d] = gap_d

        k_row = max_out_per_item
        if k_row < 1:
            k_row = 1
        if k_row > N:
            k_row = N

        vals_r, idx_r = score_row.topk(k_row, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B,N,k)
        valid_r = vals_r.isfinite()

        nz = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        b_d = nz[0]
        i_d = nz[1]
        kk = nz[2]
        j_d = idx_r[b_d, i_d, kk]
        gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Optional anchor star.
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_a = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]

    # Merge dense + anchor.
    if b_a.numel() > 0 and b_d.numel() > 0:
        b_all = torch.cat([b_d, b_a], dim=0)
        i_all = torch.cat([i_d, i_a], dim=0)
        j_all = torch.cat([j_d, j_a], dim=0)
        gap_all = torch.cat([gap_d, gap_a], dim=0)
    elif b_a.numel() > 0:
        b_all, i_all, j_all, gap_all = b_a, i_a, j_a, gap_a
    else:
        b_all, i_all, j_all, gap_all = b_d, i_d, j_d, gap_d

    # Per-instance percentile cap (vectorized via dense score tensor + sort).
    if inst_gap_quantile is not None and inst_gap_quantile > 0.0 and b_all.numel() > 0 and N > 0:
        q = inst_gap_quantile
        if q < 0.0:
            q = 0.0
        if q > 1.0:
            q = 1.0

        score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score[b_all, i_all, j_all] = gap_all

        flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
        # Sort gaps per instance; non-finite are pushed to the end.
        vals_sorted, idx_sorted = flat.sort(dim=1, descending=True)
        finite = vals_sorted.isfinite()
        cnt = finite.sum(dim=1)  # (B,)

        # Threshold rank per instance: keep approximately top (1-q) fraction among finite.
        cnt_f = cnt.to(dtype=objective.dtype)
        k_keep_f = (cnt_f * (1.0 - q))
        k_keep = k_keep_f.floor().to(dtype=torch.long)
        k_keep = torch.clamp(k_keep, min=0)

        # Gather per-instance threshold value; if k_keep==0 => keep none.
        # idx_thr = k_keep-1 (last kept element)
        idx_thr = k_keep - 1
        idx_thr = torch.clamp(idx_thr, min=0)
        b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device)
        thr = vals_sorted[b_idx, idx_thr]
        has_any = cnt > 0
        keep_any = k_keep > 0
        use_thr = has_any & keep_any
        neg_inf2 = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        thr = torch.where(use_thr, thr, thr.new_full(thr.shape, neg_inf2))

        # Keep entries with gap >= thr and finite.
        keep_mask = (flat >= thr[:, None]) & flat.isfinite() & use_thr[:, None]
        b2, pos = keep_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N
        b_all, i_all, j_all = b2, i2, j2

    # Optional global safety cap per instance after percentile filtering.
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0 and b_all.numel() > 0 and N > 0:
        score2 = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score2[b_all, i_all, j_all] = objective[b_all, j_all] - objective[b_all, i_all]

        flat2 = score2.reshape(B, N * N)
        k_eff = max_pairs_per_instance
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if flat2.shape[1] > 0 and k_eff > flat2.shape[1]:
            k_eff = flat2.shape[1]

        vals2, idx2 = flat2.topk(k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        valid2 = vals2.isfinite()
        b3 = valid2.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        pos2 = idx2[valid2]
        i3 = pos2 // N
        j3 = pos2 - i3 * N
        b_all, i_all, j_all = b3, i3, j3

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_all, i_all, j_all),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_rowcap_percentile_budget',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'max_out_per_item': int(max_out_per_item),
            'inst_gap_quantile': float(inst_gap_quantile),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
            'anchor_k': int(anchor_k),
            'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap),
        },
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}
    budget = int(hp.get('pair_budget', 1024))
    q = float(hp.get('gap_quantile', 0.9))  # keep pairs with gap >= per-instance quantile

    # Explicit constraint ops
    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))  # filter near-ties by requiring gap > tie_eps
    clamp_gap_max = float(hp.get('clamp_gap_max', 1.0e6))  # clamp gap scores for stability
    dedup_unordered = bool(hp.get('dedup_unordered', False))  # if True, keep only i<j among wins

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Strict preference direction (lower objective is better): i beats j if oi < oj.
    win_mask = oi < oj  # [B, N, N]

    # Positive gap for directed wins.
    gap = oj - oi  # [B, N, N]

    # Tie-zone filter constraint (explicit).
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        win_mask = win_mask & (gap > tie_eps)

    neg_inf = gap.new_full(gap.shape, float('-inf'))

    # Clamp gap scores constraint (explicit) to avoid extreme values dominating topk.
    gap_c = gap.clamp(min=0.0, max=clamp_gap_max)

    score = gap_c.where(win_mask, neg_inf)

    # Optional symmetric de-dup constraint: only keep i<j among wins.
    if dedup_unordered:
        ii = objective.new_empty((N, N), dtype=objective.dtype)
        ii = ii.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)
        jj = objective.new_empty((N, N), dtype=objective.dtype)
        jj = jj.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)
        # Build index grids without Python loops.
        ar = objective.new_arange(N)
        ii = ar[None, :, None].expand(B, N, N)
        jj = ar[None, None, :].expand(B, N, N)
        score = score.where(ii < jj, neg_inf)

    flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
    finite = flat.isfinite()

    # Replace -inf with 0 for quantile computation; also track if any candidates exist.
    flat_safe = flat.where(finite, flat.new_zeros(()))
    any_finite = finite.any(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # [B,1]

    # Clamp q to [0,1]. If no candidates, set threshold to +inf so mask becomes empty.
    if q < 0.0:
        q_eff = 0.0
    elif q > 1.0:
        q_eff = 1.0
    else:
        q_eff = q

    thr = flat_safe.quantile(q_eff, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    pos_inf = flat.new_full((B, 1), float('inf'))
    thr = thr.where(any_finite, pos_inf)

    # Keep only pairs above threshold.
    keep = flat >= thr
    score2 = flat.where(keep, flat.new_full(flat.shape, float('-inf')))

    # Hard per-instance budget cap (explicit constraint): always within [1, N*N].
    b_eff = budget
    if b_eff <= 0:
        b_eff = 1
    max_pairs = int(N * N)
    if b_eff > max_pairs:
        b_eff = max_pairs

    top_score, top_flat = score2.topk(b_eff, dim=1, largest=True)
    valid = top_score.isfinite()  # [B, b_eff]

    i_idx = (top_flat // N).to(dtype=top_flat.dtype)
    j_idx = (top_flat - i_idx * N).to(dtype=top_flat.dtype)

    # Extra safety constraint: remove any accidental self-pairs.
    valid = valid & (i_idx != j_idx)

    nz = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=False)
    b_idx = nz[:, 0]
    kk = nz[:, 1]

    winner_i = i_idx[b_idx, kk]
    loser_j = j_idx[b_idx, kk]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_i, loser_j),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'percentile_then_global_budget_tieclamp',
            'pair_budget': b_eff,
            'gap_quantile': q_eff,
            'tie_eps': tie_eps,
            'clamp_gap_max': clamp_gap_max,
            'dedup_unordered': dedup_unordered
        }
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Total budget across batch (0 => uncapped).
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))

    # Per-anchor percentile cap: keep pairs whose gap is >= quantile per (b,winner).
    # Example: 0.8 keeps top 20% largest gaps for each anchor.
    anchor_keep_q = float(hp.get('anchor_keep_q', 0.8))

    # Optional: add compact anchor-on-best star for extra high-gap signal.
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))  # 0 => no anchor supplement
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if anchor_keep_q < 0.0:
        anchor_keep_q = 0.0
    if anchor_keep_q > 1.0:
        anchor_keep_q = 1.0

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and not in tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # De-duplicate symmetric duplicates by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Optional: anchor-on-best star (best -> top-gap losers).
    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_idx2 = b2[picked]
        i_idx2 = w2[picked]
        j_idx2 = loser[picked]

        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_idx2], dim=0)
        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

    # Per-anchor percentile budget: for each (b, winner=i), keep only pairs above a gap quantile.
    if b_idx.numel() > 0 and anchor_keep_q > 0.0:
        gap_pairs = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
        anchor_id = b_idx * N + i_idx  # (P,)

        order = torch.argsort(anchor_id)
        anchor_s = anchor_id[order]
        b_s = b_idx[order]
        i_s = i_idx[order]
        j_s = j_idx[order]
        gap_s = gap_pairs[order]

        P = anchor_s.numel()
        new_group = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P > 1:
            new_group[1:] = anchor_s[1:] != anchor_s[:-1]
        group_id = new_group.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        G = int(group_id[-1].item()) + 1

        # Group sizes.
        ones = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = counts.scatter_add(0, group_id, ones)

        # Prepare dense (G, Lmax) gap matrix filled with -inf, then quantile over dim=1.
        Lmax = int(counts.max().item()) if G > 0 else 0
        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        pad = torch.full((G, Lmax), neg_inf, device=device, dtype=gap_s.dtype)

        starts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        if G > 1:
            starts[1:] = counts.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos = torch.arange(P, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts[group_id]

        pad[group_id, pos] = gap_s

        # Threshold per anchor via quantile; if Lmax==1 quantile is just that value.
        thresh = torch.quantile(pad, q=anchor_keep_q, dim=1)
        keep_s = gap_s >= thresh[group_id]

        b_kept = b_s[keep_s]
        i_kept = i_s[keep_s]
        j_kept = j_s[keep_s]
        gap_kept = gap_s[keep_s]

        b_idx = b_kept
        i_idx = i_kept
        j_idx = j_kept

        # Optional final global cap: strongest gaps only.
        if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs_total:
            vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_kept, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
            ok = vals.isfinite()
            sel = sel[ok]
            b_idx = b_idx[sel]
            i_idx = i_idx[sel]
            j_idx = j_idx[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_percentile_budget', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'anchor_keep_q': float(anchor_keep_q), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

ir.name: builder_anchor_percentile_budget_globaltopk
ir.intuition: Keep the same dense+best-anchor pair generation with tie-zone and de-dup, but replace rowcap/instcap with a budget allocator: reserve a fixed fraction of the global budget for anchor-star edges and spend the remaining budget on dense edges selected by a per-instance gap-percentile mask followed by a global top-k.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Total budget across the whole batch (0 => uncapped).
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))

    # Reserve a fraction of the total budget for anchor edges.
    anchor_frac = float(hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.25))

    # Anchor star: best beats up to anchor_k losers with largest objective gaps.
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 4))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    # Dense percentile (per instance): keep pairs whose gap is >= this percentile.
    # 100.0 => keep all; 90.0 => keep top 10% by gap within each instance.
    dense_keep_percentile = float(hp.get('dense_keep_percentile', 90.0))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Clamp scalar hyperparams deterministically.
    if anchor_frac < 0.0:
        anchor_frac = 0.0
    if anchor_frac > 1.0:
        anchor_frac = 1.0
    if dense_keep_percentile < 0.0:
        dense_keep_percentile = 0.0
    if dense_keep_percentile > 100.0:
        dense_keep_percentile = 100.0

    # -------- Dense directed strict-improvement candidates: i (winner) beats j (loser) if oi < oj.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one representative per unordered pair.
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        keep = i_d < j_d
        b_d = b_d[keep]
        i_d = i_d[keep]
        j_d = j_d[keep]

    gap_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # -------- Anchor star (best -> top-gap losers).
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap_to_best = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap_to_best > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap_to_best, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = top.indices[picked]

    # -------- Dense percentile filter then global budget cap.
    b_dense = b_d
    i_dense = i_d
    j_dense = j_d

    if b_dense.numel() > 0 and dense_keep_percentile < 100.0:
        # Build per-instance score matrix for quantile computation.
        score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score[b_dense, i_dense, j_dense] = objective[b_dense, j_dense] - objective[b_dense, i_dense]

        flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
        finite = flat.isfinite()
        any_finite = finite.any(dim=1, keepdim=True)

        # Convert percentile to quantile in [0,1]. Example: 90% => q=0.9.
        q = dense_keep_percentile / 100.0
        if q < 0.0:
            q = 0.0
        if q > 1.0:
            q = 1.0

        flat_safe = torch.where(finite, flat, flat.new_zeros(()))
        thr = flat_safe.quantile(q, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        thr = torch.where(any_finite, thr, flat.new_full((B, 1), float('inf')))

        keep_mask = flat >= thr
        kept = keep_mask & finite
        b2, pos = kept.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N
        b_dense, i_dense, j_dense = b2, i2, j2

    # -------- Apply global budget with anchor split.
    # If max_pairs_total<=0, leave uncapped.
    if max_pairs_total is not None and max_pairs_total > 0:
        total = max_pairs_total
        if total < 1:
            total = 1

        # Allocate anchor budget.
        a_budget = int(anchor_frac * float(total))
        if a_budget < 0:
            a_budget = 0
        if a_budget > total:
            a_budget = total
        d_budget = total - a_budget

        # Cap anchor edges by gap (if needed).
        if b_a.numel() > 0 and a_budget > 0:
            gap_a = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]
            k_a = a_budget
            if k_a > gap_a.numel():
                k_a = gap_a.numel()
            idxa = torch.topk(gap_a, k=k_a, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
            b_a = b_a[idxa]
            i_a = i_a[idxa]
            j_a = j_a[idxa]
        else:
            b_a = b_a[:0]
            i_a = i_a[:0]
            j_a = j_a[:0]

        # Cap dense edges by gap (if needed).
        if b_dense.numel() > 0 and d_budget > 0:
            gap_dense = objective[b_dense, j_dense] - objective[b_dense, i_dense]
            k_d = d_budget
            if k_d > gap_dense.numel():
                k_d = gap_dense.numel()
            idxd = torch.topk(gap_dense, k=k_d, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
            b_dense = b_dense[idxd]
            i_dense = i_dense[idxd]
            j_dense = j_dense[idxd]
        else:
            b_dense = b_dense[:0]
            i_dense = i_dense[:0]
            j_dense = j_dense[:0]

    # Merge dense + anchor.
    if b_a.numel() > 0 and b_dense.numel() > 0:
        b_all = torch.cat([b_dense, b_a], dim=0)
        i_all = torch.cat([i_dense, i_a], dim=0)
        j_all = torch.cat([j_dense, j_a], dim=0)
    elif b_a.numel() > 0:
        b_all, i_all, j_all = b_a, i_a, j_a
    else:
        b_all, i_all, j_all = b_dense, i_dense, j_dense

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_all, i_all, j_all),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_percentile_budget_globaltopk',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total),
            'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac),
            'anchor_k': int(anchor_k),
            'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap),
            'dense_keep_percentile': float(dense_keep_percentile),
        },
    )

ir.name: builder_rankband_adjacent_gapweight
ir.intuition: Paradigm shift from dense/all-pairs: build a sparse rank-band geometry by sorting candidates within each instance and only comparing adjacent items (and optionally a small neighbor band) so supervision focuses on local ordering; weight pairs by a clipped normalized objective gap to emphasize informative near-boundary differences.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    band = int(hp.get('band', 1))  # compare each item to up to `band` worse neighbors in rank order

    # Weight shaping (optional; emits 1D nonnegative weights)
    use_weight = bool(hp.get('use_weight', True))
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 5.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if band < 1:
        band = 1
    if N <= 1:
        b_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        i_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        j_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        weight = None
        if use_weight:
            weight = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx),
            weight=weight,
            meta={'builder': 'rankband_adjacent_gapweight', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band': int(band), 'use_weight': bool(use_weight), 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)},
        )

    # Rank geometry: sort by objective ascending (lower is better).
    order = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1)  # (B,N)

    # Build rank-band pairs (winner is better-ranked item, loser is worse-ranked neighbor).
    # For each offset d in [1..band], pair r with r+d.
    max_d = band
    if max_d > (N - 1):
        max_d = N - 1

    r = torch.arange(N, device=device)
    if max_d == 0:
        b_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        i_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        j_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        weight = None
        if use_weight:
            weight = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx),
            weight=weight,
            meta={'builder': 'rankband_adjacent_gapweight', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band': int(band), 'use_weight': bool(use_weight), 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)},
        )

    d = torch.arange(1, max_d + 1, device=device)  # (D,)
    rr = r[None, :, None].expand(B, N, max_d)      # (B,N,D)
    dd = d[None, None, :].expand(B, N, max_d)      # (B,N,D)

    valid = (rr + dd) < N

    w_rank = rr
    l_rank = rr + dd

    # Map ranks to original indices.
    w_idx = order.gather(1, w_rank.clamp(min=0, max=N - 1).reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, max_d)
    l_idx = order.gather(1, l_rank.clamp(min=0, max=N - 1).reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, max_d)

    # Flatten valid pairs.
    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None, None].expand(B, N, max_d)
    b_idx = b_grid[valid]
    i_idx = w_idx[valid]
    j_idx = l_idx[valid]

    # Enforce strict direction and tie-zone.
    gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]  # should be >= 0 by rank, but allow numeric ties
    keep = gap > 0
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        keep = keep & (gap > tie_eps)

    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]
    gap = gap[keep]

    weight = None
    if use_weight:
        if gap.numel() > 0:
            mean = gap.mean()
            var = (gap - mean).pow(2).mean()
            std = (var + eps).sqrt()
            z = (gap - mean) / (std + eps)
            z = z.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)
            weight = torch.clamp(z, min=0.0)
        else:
            weight = gap

    b_idx = b_idx.to(dtype=torch.int64).reshape(-1)
    i_idx = i_idx.to(dtype=torch.int64).reshape(-1)
    j_idx = j_idx.to(dtype=torch.int64).reshape(-1)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx),
        weight=weight,
        meta={'builder': 'rankband_adjacent_gapweight', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band': int(band), 'use_weight': bool(use_weight), 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip), 'pairs': int(b_idx.numel())},
    )

ir.name: builder_allpairs_tie_dedup_colcap_norm_005
ir.intuition: All-pairs builder with tie-zone filtering and symmetric de-dup, then an explicit per-loser-column top-k constraint to cap incoming edges per candidate; uses stable gap normalization and clamping while preserving pairwise PrefBatch output.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    max_in_per_item = int(hp.get('max_in_per_item', 0))  # 0 => uncapped per (b,j) column
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Candidate strict preference edges (lower objective is better): i beats j.
    better = oi < oj

    # Constraint: tie-zone filter.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Constraint: de-duplicate symmetric pairs by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Gap for scoring; normalize and clamp for stability.
    gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
    if gap.numel() > 0:
        mean = gap.mean()
        var = (gap - mean).pow(2).mean()
        std = (var + eps).sqrt()
        gap_n = (gap - mean) / (std + eps)
    else:
        gap_n = gap
    gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Explicit constraint: cap incoming edges per loser column (b,j) to prevent a single item
    # from being the target of too many comparisons within an instance.
    if max_in_per_item is not None and max_in_per_item > 0 and N > 0:
        score_col = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score_col[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap_n

        k_col = max_in_per_item if max_in_per_item < N else N
        # Top-k along winner dimension for each fixed (b, j).
        vals_c, idx_c = score_col.topk(k_col, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B,k,N)
        valid_c = vals_c.isfinite()

        nz = valid_c.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        b2 = nz[0]
        k2 = nz[1]
        j2 = nz[2]
        i2 = idx_c[b2, k2, j2]

        b_idx = b2
        i_idx = i2
        j_idx = j2

        gap_sel = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
        if gap_sel.numel() > 0:
            mean2 = gap_sel.mean()
            var2 = (gap_sel - mean2).pow(2).mean()
            std2 = (var2 + eps).sqrt()
            gap_n = (gap_sel - mean2) / (std2 + eps)
        else:
            gap_n = gap_sel
        gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Constraint: per-instance top-k cap to avoid one instance dominating pair volume.
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0:
        score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap_n

        flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
        k_eff = max_pairs_per_instance
        if flat.shape[1] > 0:
            k_eff = k_eff if k_eff < flat.shape[1] else flat.shape[1]
        vals, idx = flat.topk(k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)

        valid = vals.isfinite()
        nz2 = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        b3 = nz2[0]
        pos = idx[valid]
        i3 = pos // N
        j3 = pos - i3 * N

        b_idx = b3
        i_idx = i3
        j_idx = j3

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tie_dedup_colcap_norm', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_in_per_item': int(max_in_per_item) if max_in_per_item is not None else 0, 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance) if max_pairs_per_instance is not None else 0, 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

ir.name: builder_rank_band_neighbors_softw
ir.intuition: Paradigm shift from dense/all-pairs to rank-band neighbor pairing: compare each item only to a small window of nearby ranks (hard and semi-hard), yielding local ordering pressure with optional gap-shaped nonnegative weights.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Rank-band geometry: compare each rank position p to a few worse ranks p+d.
    # hard_band => closest neighbors; semi_band => a bit further away.
    hard_band = int(hp.get('hard_band', 2))
    semi_band = int(hp.get('semi_band', 6))

    # If >0, cap total emitted pairs per instance by taking top-k weights.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))

    # Optional soft weights based on gap in objective.
    w_temp = float(hp.get('w_temp', 1.0))
    w_clip = float(hp.get('w_clip', 50.0))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if N <= 1:
        b_empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        i_empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        j_empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_empty, i_empty, j_empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_neighbors_softw', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'hard_band': int(hard_band), 'semi_band': int(semi_band), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance)})

    # Sort by objective ascending (lower is better). pos 0 is best.
    order = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, descending=False)  # (B,N)

    # Rank positions for winners p and offsets d where loser is at p+d (worse).
    d_hard = hard_band
    d_semi = semi_band
    if d_hard < 0:
        d_hard = 0
    if d_semi < d_hard:
        d_semi = d_hard
    if d_semi > (N - 1):
        d_semi = N - 1

    # Build offset vector: [1..d_hard] U [d_hard+2..d_semi+1] (skip immediate boundary to diversify).
    # Implemented without Python loops over pairs: construct two arange blocks.
    off1 = torch.arange(1, d_hard + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.long) if d_hard > 0 else torch.empty((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    start2 = d_hard + 2
    off2 = torch.arange(start2, d_semi + 2, device=device, dtype=torch.long) if d_semi + 1 >= start2 else torch.empty((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    offsets = torch.cat([off1, off2], dim=0)

    K = int(offsets.numel())
    if K == 0:
        b_empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        i_empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        j_empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_empty, i_empty, j_empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_neighbors_softw', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'hard_band': int(hard_band), 'semi_band': int(semi_band), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance)})

    p = torch.arange(N, device=device, dtype=torch.long)  # (N,)
    p2 = p[:, None]  # (N,1)
    q = p2 + offsets[None, :]  # (N,K)

    valid_pq = q < N  # (N,K)

    # Map (rank positions) -> (item indices).
    p_idx = p2.expand(N, K)
    p_idx = torch.where(valid_pq, p_idx, p_idx.new_zeros(()))
    q_idx = torch.where(valid_pq, q, q.new_zeros(()))

    winners = order[:, p_idx]  # (B,N,K)
    losers = order[:, q_idx]   # (B,N,K)

    # Compute gap (loser - winner) in objective space.
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winners.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, K)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, losers.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, K)
    gap = obj_l - obj_w  # (B,N,K)

    # Keep only strict improvements and not near ties.
    keep = valid_pq[None, :, :].expand(B, N, K) & (gap > 0)
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        keep = keep & (gap > tie_eps)

    # Flatten to pair list.
    keep_f = keep.reshape(-1)
    if keep_f.any():
        # Build flattened indices without iterating pairs.
        b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None, None].expand(B, N, K)
        b_idx = b_grid.reshape(-1)[keep_f]
        i_idx = winners.reshape(-1)[keep_f]
        j_idx = losers.reshape(-1)[keep_f]

        # Optional nonnegative soft weights emphasizing larger gaps but saturating.
        g = gap.reshape(-1)[keep_f]
        if w_temp <= 0.0:
            w_temp = 1.0
        x = (g / w_temp).clamp(-w_clip, w_clip)
        weight = torch.sigmoid(x)

        # Optional per-instance cap: keep top-k weights per batch item.
        if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0:
            score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), 0.0)

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Cap outgoing edges per (batch, winner row). 0 => uncapped.
    max_out_per_item = int(hp.get('max_out_per_item', 32))

    # Cap total pairs per instance after merge. 0 => uncapped.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 256))

    # Optional best-anchor star (best -> top-gap losers).

    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense strict-improvement candidates.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one representative per unordered pair.
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        keep = i_d < j_d
        b_d = b_d[keep]
        i_d = i_d[keep]
        j_d = j_d[keep]

    # Score by objective gap (loser - winner), larger is stronger.
    gap_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Row-cap on dense pairs to prevent a single (b,i) winner dominating.
    if max_out_per_item is not None and max_out_per_item > 0 and N > 0 and b_d.numel() > 0:
        score_row = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score_row[b_d, i_d, j_d] = gap_d

        k_row = max_out_per_item
        if k_row < 1:
            k_row = 1
        if k_row > N:
            k_row = N

        vals_r, idx_r = score_row.topk(k_row, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B,N,k)
        valid_r = vals_r.isfinite()

        nz = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        b_d = nz[0]
        i_d = nz[1]
        kk = nz[2]
        j_d = idx_r[b_d, i_d, kk]
        gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Optional anchor star.
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b2 = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        pos = idx[valid]
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N

        b_all, i_all, j_all = b2, i2, j2

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_all, i_all, j_all),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_rowcap_instance_budget_m2',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'max_out_per_item': int(max_out_per_item),

    device = objective.device

        b_d = b_d[keep]

        j_d = j_d[keep]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Caps: first per-instance, then global. 0 => uncapped.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))

    # Optional anchor star.
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    # Normalized gap scoring constraints.
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and not in tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Optional: anchor-on-best star (best -> top-gap losers).
    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_idx2 = b2[picked]
        i_idx2 = w2[picked]
        j_idx2 = loser[picked]

        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_idx2], dim=0)
        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

    # Explicit constraint stage: normalize per-instance gap scores, clamp, then apply caps.
    P = b_idx.numel()
    if P > 0:
        gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]

        # Per-instance normalization (z-score within each batch instance) with clamp.
        gap_sum = torch.zeros(B, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        gap_sum = gap_sum.scatter_add(0, b_idx, gap)
        ones = torch.ones(P, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        cnt = torch.zeros(B, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        cnt = cnt.scatter_add(0, b_idx, ones)
        mean = gap_sum / (cnt + eps)

        gap2_sum = torch.zeros(B, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        gap2_sum = gap2_sum.scatter_add(0, b_idx, gap * gap)
        var = gap2_sum / (cnt + eps) - mean * mean
        var = torch.clamp(var, min=0.0)
        std = torch.sqrt(var + eps)

        gnorm = (gap - mean[b_idx]) / std[b_idx]
        gnorm = torch.clamp(gnorm, -gap_clip, gap_clip)

        # Per-instance cap via stable sort on (b_idx, -gnorm) and keep first K per b.
        if max_pairs_per_instance and max_pairs_per_instance > 0 and P > 1:
            gmin = gnorm.min()
            gmax = gnorm.max()
            span = torch.clamp(gmax - gmin, min=1.0)
            comp = b_idx.to(gnorm.dtype) * (span + 1.0) + (gmax - gnorm) / (span + 1.0)
            order = torch.argsort(comp)

            b_s = b_idx[order]
            i_s = i_idx[order]
            j_s = j_idx[order]
            g_s = gnorm[order]

            P2 = b_s.numel()
            new_group = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
            new_group[1:] = b_s[1:] != b_s[:-1]
            group = new_group.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1  # (P2,)
            G = int(group[-1].item()) + 1

            one_i = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            counts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            counts = counts.scatter_add(0, group, one_i)
            starts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            if G > 1:
                starts[1:] = counts.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
            pos = torch.arange(P2, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts[group]

            keep2 = pos < max_pairs_per_instance
            b_idx = b_s[keep2]
            i_idx = i_s[keep2]
            j_idx = j_s[keep2]
            gnorm = g_s[keep2]

        # Final global top-k cap on normalized gaps.
        if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs_total:
            vals, sel = torch.topk(gnorm, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
            ok = vals.isfinite()
            sel = sel[ok]
            b_idx = b_idx[sel]
            i_idx = i_idx[sel]
            j_idx = j_idx[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_anchor_normgap_budgeted', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap), 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

    eq_best = objective == best_val[:, None]  # (B,K)
    first_best = eq_best & (eq_best.cumsum(dim=1) == 1)
    best_idx = first_best.to(torch.int64).argmax(dim=1)  # (B,)

    # ---- Anchor star: best vs worst-k.
    worst_k = min(K, anchor_k)
    if worst_k > 0:
        _, worst_idx = torch.topk(objective, k=worst_k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B,kw)
        b_a = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)[:, None].expand(B, worst_k).reshape(-1)
        w_a = best_idx[:, None].expand(B, worst_k).reshape(-1)
        l_a = worst_idx.reshape(-1)
        gap_a = objective[b_a, l_a] - objective[b_a, w_a]
        ok = l_a != w_a
        if tie_eps > 0.0:
            ok = ok & (gap_a > tie_eps)
        b_a = b_a[ok]
        w_a = w_a[ok]
        l_a = l_a[ok]
        gap_a = gap_a[ok]
    else:
        b_a = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        w_a = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        l_a = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        gap_a = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)

    # ---- Dense all-pairs (i<j), pick winner by objective.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    tri = torch.triu(torch.ones((K, K), device=device, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1)

    diff = oj - oi  # (B,K,K)
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        valid = (torch.abs(diff) > tie_eps) & tri[None, :, :]
    else:
        valid = (diff != 0) & tri[None, :, :]

    b_d, i_d, j_d = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    i_better = (oi < oj)[b_d, i_d, j_d]
    w_d = torch.where(i_better, i_d.to(torch.int64), j_d.to(torch.int64))
    l_d = torch.where(i_better, j_d.to(torch.int64), i_d.to(torch.int64))

    gap_d = torch.abs(diff[b_d, i_d, j_d])

    # ---- Combine and cap by decisive gaps.
    b_all = torch.cat([b_a, b_d.to(torch.int64)], dim=0)
    w_all = torch.cat([w_a, w_d.to(torch.int64)], dim=0)
    l_all = torch.cat([l_a, l_d.to(torch.int64)], dim=0)
    gap_all = torch.cat([gap_a, gap_d], dim=0)

    g = torch.clamp(gap_all, 0.0, gap_clip)
    denom = g.mean() + eps if g.numel() > 0 else torch.tensor(1.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    weight = g / denom

    if max_pairs_total > 0 and b_all.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        max_anchor = int(max_pairs_total * anchor_frac)
        if max_anchor < 0:
            max_anchor = 0
        if max_anchor > max_pairs_total:
            max_anchor = max_pairs_total
        max_dense = max_pairs_total - max_anchor

        na = b_a.numel()
        # Cap anchor portion (take top gaps); slicing is fine when already under budget.
        if na > 0 and max_anchor > 0 and na > max_anchor:
            _, sel_a = torch.topk(weight[:na], k=max_anchor, largest=True, sorted=False)
            b_a2 = b_a[sel_a]
            w_a2 = w_a[sel_a]
            l_a2 = l_a[sel_a]
            gap_a2 = gap_a[sel_a]
        else:
            b_a2, w_a2, l_a2, gap_a2 = b_a, w_a, l_a, gap_a

        nd = b_d.numel()
        if nd > 0 and max_dense > 0 and nd > max_dense:
            _, sel_d = torch.topk(weight[na:], k=max_dense, largest=True, sorted=False)
            b_d2 = b_d.to(torch.int64)[sel_d]
            w_d2 = w_d.to(torch.int64)[sel_d]
            l_d2 = l_d.to(torch.int64)[sel_d]
            gap_d2 = gap_d[sel_d]
        else:
            b_d2 = b_d.to(torch.int64)
            w_d2 = w_d.to(torch.int64)
            l_d2 = l_d.to(torch.int64)
            gap_d2 = gap_d

        b_all = torch.cat([b_a2, b_d2], dim=0)
        w_all = torch.cat([w_a2, w_d2], dim=0)
        l_all = torch.cat([l_a2, l_d2], dim=0)
        gap_all = torch.cat([gap_a2, gap_d2], dim=0)

        g = torch.clamp(gap_all, 0.0, gap_clip)
        denom = g.mean() + eps if g.numel() > 0 else torch.tensor(1.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        weight = g / denom

    pair_idx = (
        b_all.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
        w_all.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
        l_all.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
    )
    meta = {
        'tie_eps': tie_eps,
        'max_pairs_total': max_pairs_total,
        'anchor_frac': anchor_frac,
        'anchor_k': anchor_k,
        'num_anchor_pairs': int(b_a.numel()),
        'num_dense_pairs': int(b_d.numel()),
    }
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weight, meta=meta)
